items.name: Shepherd's Crook-Pin
items.lore: A little silver crook. Kerra's mother wore it, and her mother.

items.name: White Fang Necklace
items.lore: A long white canine on a leather thong. It was hard won.

items.name: Moor-Grass Cloak
items.lore: Woven of Cornish wool and dyed the colour of the moor in autumn.

items.name: Stalker-Bone Ring
items.lore: Carved from a death stalker's bone. Cold to wear.

items.name: Eagle of the Ninth
items.lore: A legion's bronze eagle, small enough now to wear. It was carried into the marsh four hundred years ago.

items.name: Kit's Heather Wreath
items.lore: A wreath of dried heather, bound with red thread. It does not crumble.

items.name: Legionary Cingulum
items.lore: A soldier's belt of bronze plates. The leather is new; the bronze is very old.

items.name: Standard-Bearer's Cape
items.lore: A wolfskin cape, of the kind a legion's standard-bearer wore over his helm.
